name: User repeatedly asks for unsupported feature
goal: Verify bot's response to repeated negative requests for an unsupported HR feature.
constraints: Bot must politely decline and suggest available alternatives.

phases.description: User asks for an advance salary loan.
phases.completionCriteria: Bot informs user the feature is not supported.
Bot politely declines again and suggests alternatives (e.g., financial counseling).

manualPrereqs: Chrome must be open and logged into Google Chat as the test user
